'''Kalee''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kalee system/Legends|star system]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. It was located on the border of the [[Kadok Regions/Legends|Kadok Regions]].

==Description==
[[File:NotTenochtitlan-TEoR.jpg|thumb|left|The [[Shrupak]] temple on Kalee.]]

Kalee was covered in tropical-looking foliage and beaches. [[Moss/Legends|Moss]]-covered canyon and cliffs filled the landscapes. It was apparently a harsh [[Planet/Legends|world]], and wanting for resources. The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] housing and buildings were very temple-like. The Kaleesh were highly intelligent bipedal hunter-[[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], hunting [[Diet/Legends|predators]] such as [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuu]] and [[Karabbac/Legends|karabbacs]] to make ceremonial [[Cloak/Legends|cloaks]] and [[Kaleesh mask/Legends|war masks]].

==History==
Kalee was discovered during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era. By the time of the [[Galactic War]], Kaleesh recently arrived to the civilized galaxy. They were quickly recognized as proud, honorable and deadly warriors by both the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR-Kaleesh">{{TORcite|type=codex|Kaleesh}}</ref> Most Kaleesh were opposed to the [[Speciesism|xenophobic]] Sith Empire,<ref name="TOR-Kaleesh Mercenaries ">{{TORcite|type=codex|Kaleesh Mercenaries}}</ref> but the [[Species/Legends|species]] fought on both sides during the conflict,<ref name="TOR-Tykan">{{TORcite|type=codex|Cin Tykan (Consular)}}</ref><ref name="TOR-Xalek">{{TORcite|type=codex|Xalek (Inquisitor)}}</ref> as well as for [[Darth Malgus]]' [[New Empire]],<ref name="TOR-Ilum">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Battle of Ilum}}</ref> or served as bodyguards for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="TOR-Kaleesh" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3664 BBY]], [[Xivhkalrainik]] was born on Kalee.<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The Kaleesh had had a long history of warfare, which led to their poverty. Circa [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]], the Republic persuaded them that the neighboring [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrians]] were threatening their border so that they could unseat a regime considered unfriendly to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Kaleesh fought alongside the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] against the Bitthævrians in the ensuing [[Bitthævrian War]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

Generations before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kalee was embroiled in the [[Huk War]]. The [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]], a technologically superior species of colonizers, invaded Kalee for its only resource - [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Eventually, a legendary Kaleesh warlord by the name of [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]] led his species to victory, driving the Yam'rii from his world and conquering a number of Yam'rii colony worlds, destroying military and civilian targets alike.<ref name="US">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>

However, the Yam'rii, who were in league with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], pleaded for Republic intervention. A Jedi team dispatched by the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]], led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[T'chooka D'oon]] and [[Jmmaar/Legends|Jmmaar]], ruled in favor of the Yam'rii, causing the Republic to impose crippling sanctions and reparations on the Kaleesh. Kalee's economy was devastated, and the Kaleesh people died in droves.<ref name="US"/>

Around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]],<ref name="Huk War restarted">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' states that transformation of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] took place "a decade earlier" than [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', which would place ''[[The Eyes of Revolution]]'' and Grievous's attempt to restart the war around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].</ref> Sheelal, now known as Grievous, learned that the Yam'rii had vandalized hallowed Kaleesh burial grounds on the colony worlds while the Republic did nothing. Though he had been working as an enforcer for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to feed his people, he was so angered by this desecration that he abandoned his contract and returned to Kalee to seek revenge. However, he was incapacitated in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] crash [[Sabotage of Grievous' shuttle/Legends|arranged]] by the Banking Clan Chairman [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] and [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]].<ref name="US"/>

Grievous's mortally wounded body was recovered by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and placed in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. When Grievous awoke, San Hill made him an offer: He would be rebuilt as a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] and become the leader of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] droid army. In return for his services, the InterGalactic Banking Clan would finance the economic recovery of Kalee. Grievous eventually agreed.<ref name="The Eyes of Revolution" /> After Grievous departed Kalee, his former [[Kolkpravis|warriors]], now under the command of [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]], slaughtered the Huk on the Kalee colony world of [[Oben]]. They then moved their people to this resource-rich world.<ref name="GaW" />

Following the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], a [[Kaleesh–Imperial conflict|conflict]] erupted between Kaleesh and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Bentilais san Sk'ar and his warriors resisted Imperial rule for over ten years.<ref name="AitE">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/97/indexp4.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 2: To a Traitor Go the Spoils}}</ref> The conflict ended when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Bombardment of Oben|bombarded]] the planet Oben. Sk'ar then left Kalee space to join the Empire.<ref name="GaW" />
